matches.rationale: Finding 1 identifies exactly the same defect: Theorem 3.3's addition of a log-sum-exp normalization term to the logit-level LS loss, correctly noting it should cancel per the original derivation, matching the ground truth's description of an inconsistent partition-function term.

Ground truth concerns the gradient derivation in Section 3.2 (Eq. 9) contradicting the mean-logit dependency in the MaxSup loss, but Finding 2 instead discusses Definition 3.5/Eqs. (6)-(8) about z_max vs z_gt in the loss definition itself, a different locus and different claimed inconsistency.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly identifies the erroneous log-sum-exp term added to the logit-level LS loss in Theorem 3.3.

Misreads the paper's intentional substitution of z_max for z_gt (the core MaxSup design choice) as an inconsistency, and does not correspond to the gradient-analysis defect described in the ground truth.
